findings: API key in client-side source — `API_KEY` is a plain string in `app.js` and ships to the browser. Any user with DevTools can read it. For anything beyond a local/demo use, move API calls to a backend proxy and keep the key server-side.

`--card-color-rgb` never defined — `.milestone-box` uses `rgba(var(--card-color-rgb, 6, 182, 212), 0.08)` but JS only sets `--card-color` (hex). The milestone gradient always renders cyan regardless of phase color. Fix by setting `--card-color-rgb` alongside `--card-color` in `createPhaseCard`, or rewrite the gradient using `color-mix()`.
